messages:
maya: Quick preflight - proposing we unpin runtime 2.14 from canary in the Tue 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC change window. KV-cache fix validated in staging, SDK shim looks good. Need infra + QA sign-off and runbook link. @sam @jordan

sam: infra side looks green. Load tests (1000rps, 16s seq) show no throughput regression. Did QA run the long-seq suite?

jordan: QA ran long-seq overnight (30m). Observed ~3% p99 token latency bump on one prompt set (prompt_set_b). No correctness failures. Captured logs and diff here.

maya: Thanks. Priya, can you do a dedicated-cluster smoke and confirm rollback steps? We should also add an SDK compatibility blurb to the release notes.

priya: Dedicated cluster smoke passed. Rollback plan: redeploy pin to runtime-2.13 via deploy-bot tag, see runbook. I prepared a short runbook snippet and set auto-rollback thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled unpin runtime-2.14 on canary at 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z by maya. ID: dpl-20260323-01. To abort: `deploy-bot cancel dpl-20260323-01`.

sam: Small checklist note: SDK 1.4.2 is required for the new KV semantics. If customers can't upgrade, they can set `RW_USE_LEGACY_KV=1` as a temporary shim. Add that to release notes.

maya: Added to release notes draft: "Runtime 2.14 unpin includes kv-cache rework; requires SDK >= 1.4.2. For older SDKs set RW_USE_LEGACY_KV=1 (temporary)." Will include code snippet for env var.

jordan: ACK. Confirmed auto-rollback policy: p99 increase >5% OR error-rate spike >2% triggers rollback. Priya, did you set the metric hooks?

priya: Yep. Metric hooks and alerting are live in the canary policy. Runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/unpin-2026-03-23 (contains rollback commands and contact list).

maya: OK all good from me. I'll flip the schedule to active and post updates during the window. T-15m I'll post the preflight status here. :rocket:

sam: Thanks — ping if anything unexpected, otherwise we'll watch tracing and cost dashboards.

maya: Canary unpin started; monitoring p99 and ops trace. (dpl-20260323-01 in progress)
__important_note: This JSON represents a Slack thread; messages are in chronological order and prefixed with sender display names. No title field as per agents.md.
